text:
Ryan O'Reilly is 35, playing more than 20 minutes a night, and doing it on a Nashville team that keeps getting out-shot. With him on the ice at five on five, the Predators have taken just 43% of the shot attempts and 46% of the expected goals. Yet they won eight of the ten games before last weekend, and he has 21 points in 23 games, 10 on the power play.

Some of that is finishing. He's shooting 22% against a league norm of 13.5, with 9 goals on 6.6 expected, and our range puts his true rate between 13% and 18%. His goals have counted, too: our wins-added measure has him 34th of 560 skaters.

He also gave Nashville a scare last week, leaving practice early before being cleared to play Saturday, Sports Illustrated and CBS Sports reported. Now NHLTradeRumor.com has his name in Minnesota trade buzz after the Wild missed on Dylan Larkin. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had his shot assists in the 93rd percentile last season. Watch whether Nashville's results keep outrunning the shot share; that gap usually closes.
